name: Kaa-san ga Boku no Tomodachi ni Otosareru Made
original_name: 母さんが僕の友達に堕とされるまで
source:
Dad is long gone, and mom teaches at her son's school.
One day her son catches her in a forbidden affair with a classmate.
He decides to watch her debauchery at repeated rendevous spot... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE060633.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
父亲早已不在身边，母亲则在儿子就读的学校任教。
某天，儿子撞见她与自己的同学发生了禁忌关系。
他决定前往两人一再密会的地点，窥视母亲沉沦于淫乱之中的模样……

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE060633.html]DLsite英文站[/url]]
